data.name: Hakodate 1983: A City Pop Delivery Story
data.detailed_description:
📖 3D Visual Novel: Interact with diverse 3D residents of Hakodate and visit their fully rendered 3D spaces (offices, shops, workshops, and more).

❤️ Romance: Pursue a romance with one of the hand-drawn 3D beauties (because what's a visual novel without a little love?), or stay a lone wolf if that's more your style.

🚚 Arcade "Snake": The game originated as a 3D Snake spin-off where your "tail" is a growing convoy of delivery trucks dropping off cargo. Once the main focus, it’s now a fun secondary mode—hence the title change!

🏙️ City Builder: As you make deliveries, the city expands automatically—evolving from traditional houses into modern glass skyscrapers. Unlocking landmark buildings brings new characters to town (such as the Broadcasting Center).

🚗 Vehicles: Earn unique vehicles for your garage by building strong relationships with each character.

🎨 Unique Style: Every visual in the game is hand-painted by me and my YouTube community. Through free mentorship, I guide them in hand-texturing 3D models, personally reviewing and touching up each piece to maintain a cohesive artistic direction. It’s a painstaking process, but it gives the game its unique soul.

data.short_description: Embark on a 30-day assignment in 1980s Hakodate! Explore the city behind the wheel of a delivery car, develop the infrastructure by hauling cargo, and build personal connections with the locals.
data.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (12th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics / AMD Radeon Graphics (Vulkan 1.2 support required)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan 1.2 compatible hardware
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan 1.2 compatible hardware
